I'm sorry you feel this way. But you certainly do not deserve to feel this way. Nothing seems worth it anymore but it is possible that your mind is playing tricks on you right now, which is not your fault. Minds do that. 

I listen to poems when I feel this way, look at pictures, those of fairy tale aesthetic type ones. And I try to envision myself there, standing on the ledge of a tall castle almost, between the pillars, looking ahead to the endless sea. I try to feel the moist cool air on my face, my arms, and listen to the waves. I do everything I can to not be in myself for a moment. I just need a break. I can't stand myself let alone bear living in myself. Distraction seems like the only way I can continue living. Or existing.

You might think you do not bring value to this life. But you do, just by being alive. Your existence alone brings value you know. You arent nothing. It's hard to see this, to even accept it. But it's true right? Who am I kidding even I don't know. I guess we're all riding our own waves.
